Hannah Li: Quick note  PhoenixCommerce pilot fell to ~25% traffic overnight. Their lead left and a new Director of ML (Rae) joined. They're running a 10-day POC with AsterAI; renewal in 5 weeks. Need a rapid triage and a win-back offer.

Owen Brooks: Yikes. Can we get the topline numbers and recent errors?

Hannah Li: Top snapshot:
```
7d_calls: 1,150 (prev 4,600)
7d_tokens: 3.2M (prev 13.5M)
error_rate: 1.2% (prev 0.4%)
avg_p95: 640ms (prev 320ms)
```
No infra deploys on our side. Customer mentioned an SDK upgrade and a cost cap flip.

Tasha Nguyen: Support ticket #5012 shows repeated `partial_response` and `rate_limit` from their side. Also they lowered max batch to 2 in client. I can repro p95 spikes locally with their sample prompts.

Miguel Santos: Suggest two-track plan: 1) Outreach to Rae for a 30m audit to confirm eval criteria (p95 vs cost vs answer quality). 2) Offer a 7-day recovery sprint: infra triage + client patch + optional 14-day Dedicated trial for busiest route.

Hannah Li: Agreed. Draft outreach: "Hi Rae  Hannah from Redwood CS. Noticed traffic drop during your POC. Can we do a 30m audit this week? We'll bring a perf/cost sketch and quick wins to recover throughput." Add Thu 3pm PT / Fri 11am PT.

Owen Brooks: I'll prep a short repro harness and a golden config: async batching, max_batch_size:16, prefix_cache:true. Also run a synthetic showing throughput uplift.

Tasha Nguyen: I'll escalate ticket #5012 and share client diffs. If they want pricing for a Dedicated trial, loop AE.

infra-bot: alert: kv-cache miss rate increased at 2065432300  infra notified.

Hannah Li: Outreach sent, Rae replied "Can do Fri 11am PT." Tentative booked. Action owners: Owen (bench + numbers), Tasha (ticket triage + diffs), Miguel (trial proposal + renewal timeline). Will update after Fri. :thumbsup:
